fixes.explanation: The whole land of Canaan isn't what the text gives. It says Balaam “…could see the outskirts of the camp of the people.” (Numbers 22:41). That's the view the text names, so that's the one to hold onto. It's like peeking through a bakery keyhole and telling everybody you saw the doormat.
The text says Peor “…overlooks the wasteland.” (Numbers 23:28). That's the third spot Balak picks, and I think he's running low on scenic options. Wasteland is the word to keep.

problems.problem: “Just the edges of the camp, nothing more” claims the view was limited to the outskirts. The text says the outskirts could be seen, not that nothing else was visible.
“Third mountain” treats all three locations as mountains, but the passage does not identify Bamoth-baal or Peor as mountains.
